title: Block-weighted random graphs: planar and beyond
summary: We investigate random connected graphs from a block-stable class whose distribution is weighted based on the number of $2$-connected components, or blocks. This includes the class of planar graphs. For this, we develop a notion of a decorated block tree. Following similar ideas to Fleurat and the second author on block-weighted planar maps, we find a phase transition in the singular behaviour of the appropriate generating function and in the typical structure of the block tree.
